title: #14 Overpackage
prompt: Do you think consumers should avoid over-packaged products or is it the responsibility of manufacturers to avoid extra packaging? Give your views or any relevant examples based on your own experience.

promptTraps.en: Do not write off-topic generalizations; ground every point in the specific context of Environment.

promptTraps.en: Avoid memorized generic templates; ensure every body paragraph contains concrete reasoning and evidence.
promptTraps.vi: Tránh các câu rập khuôn học thuộc lòng; hãy đảm bảo mỗi thân bài đều có lập luận và dẫn chứng cụ thể.
